tasks.typecheck: deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc --noEmit && deno check --unstable-sloppy-imports build.ts scripts/test-search.ts src/obsidian-ex.d.ts src/globals.test.ts src/components/*.test.ts src/test-utils/*.ts
tasks.fmtlint: deno task fmt && deno task lint
tasks.prebuild: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint:check && deno task typecheck
tasks.build: deno task prebuild && deno run -A build.ts production
tasks.build:rust: cd napi && deno run -A npm:@napi-rs/cli build --release
tasks.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p ferrisearch-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ferrisearch_wasm.wasm
tasks.build:all: deno task build:rust && deno task build:wasm && deno task build
